name: CISA KEV
summary: Laelaps — CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities on your assets, joined to CISA's catalog: remediation due dates (overdue / due soon), ransomware use, crown jewels and vendors. Tags assets CISA KEV:Vulnerable (xref), by catalog date added, by CISA due date (CISA KEV Due:<YYYY-MM-DD>) and CISA KEV:Ransomware. Plus an NL→SQL to hunt KEV in navi.db / tags.

widgets.title: Open KEV findings
widgets.note: Open findings for a CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability (catalog match, like this page).
widgets.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Open KEV findings" FROM vulns v WHERE $__open(v) AND $__kev(v) AND $__scope(v.asset_uuid)
widgets.drill: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(v.asset_hostname,''), v.asset_ip) AS host, v.asset_ip AS ip, v.plugin_id, v.plugin_name, v.cves, v.severity, v.first_found, v.asset_uuid FROM vulns v WHERE $__open(v) AND $__kev(v) AND $__scope(v.asset_uuid) ORDER BY host

widgets.title: KEV assets by owner
widgets.note: Who has to fix the known-exploited exposure (ownerless shown as “No owner”).
widgets.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT t.tag_value FROM tags t WHERE t.tag_key='Owner' AND t.asset_uuid=v.asset_uuid LIMIT 1),'No owner') AS owner, COUNT(DISTINCT v.asset_uuid) AS assets FROM vulns v WHERE $__open(v) AND $__kev(v) AND $__scope(v.asset_uuid) GROUP BY owner ORDER BY assets DESC LIMIT 15
